name: Shipping Method
purpose: Decides express or standard from weight and destination. Send weight or destination, separated by spaces; it answers express or standard, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: SM-01: the app always answers express when destination is worldwide. SM-02: the app never answers standard when destination is worldwide.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  destination is worldwide → express
  weight is above 20 → express
  otherwise → standard
proposition.plain: Decides express or standard from weight and destination.
